canonical_source.behavior: When an authoritative active site exists, CurrentUserChip exposes a navigation control to that site's settings surface. The control itself is read/navigation-only; mutations inside SiteSettings are separate canonical operations.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The CurrentUserChip control renders only for an authoritative active-site contract and sites.manage permission. It derives tenant and site identifiers from FrontendContext and navigates to a real server-rendered tenant-scoped settings landing that re-authorizes and re-resolves the site.

authorization.activation_recheck: The destination controller independently authorizes tenant.view and sites.manage; frontend visibility is not trusted as authorization.

tenant_isolation.proof: Focused acceptance proves a caller without membership in the requested tenant receives 404 and a site ID belonging to another active tenant is 404 under the requested tenant context.
tenant_isolation.direct_id_idor: The URL carries a site identifier because the canonical source does, but Site::query() executes under the activated tenant global scope and cannot resolve a foreign-tenant site ID.

coverage: real CurrentUserChip integration renders the exact canonical marker
tenant/site target derives only from authoritative FrontendContext
missing permission/active site/exact site API contract fails closed
no unrelated settings mutations are simulated

terminality.basis: The exact visible navigation behavior is wired to a real tenant-scoped destination with independent server authorization and cross-tenant ID isolation, while all unrelated settings mutations remain unclaimed.
